journey.label: Explore the Shop Direct purchase paths
journey.surface: Amazon search and Alexa for Shopping

paths.title: Visit the merchant
paths.heading: Discovery brings the shopper to you
paths.description: Shop Direct can link to products on your own site. The shopper visits your website to buy.
paths.condition: The merchant website is the purchase destination.

paths.title: Buy for Me
paths.heading: An agent buys on the merchant’s site
paths.description: For eligible Buy for Me offers, Amazon’s agent completes the purchase on the merchant’s website.
paths.condition: Buy for Me is available only for eligible offers.

catalog.label: The catalog supply path
catalog.route: Solution provider or Selling Partner API

steps.title: Register
steps.description: Manage participation through the free Shop Direct Merchant Workspace. An Amazon marketplace store is not required.

steps.title: Verify your website
steps.description: Website verification is required. Eligible merchants can participate even if they also sell on Amazon.

steps.title: Share your catalog
steps.description: Supply catalog information through a solution provider or Amazon’s Selling Partner API.
